# `Encoding`

[Back to stdlib index](../stdlib.md)

Ipe.Encoding — text encoding helpers.

String-to-String codecs for base64, percent (URL), and hex encodings.
Each encoder is total (`String -> String`); each decoder returns
`Result Error String` because the input may be malformed.

Non-UTF-8 binary payloads should go through `Ipe.Bytes` instead.

## `base64Encode`

```ipe
base64Encode : String -> String
```

Base64-encode a string (RFC 4648 standard alphabet, with padding).

## `base64Decode`

```ipe
base64Decode : String -> Result Error String
```

Base64-decode a string.

Returns `Err` when the input contains characters outside the base64
alphabet or has invalid padding.

## `urlEncode`

```ipe
urlEncode : String -> String
```

Percent-encode a string for use in a URL component (RFC 3986).

## `urlDecode`

```ipe
urlDecode : String -> Result Error String
```

Percent-decode a URL-encoded string.

Returns `Err` when the input contains a malformed percent-escape sequence.

## `hexEncode`

```ipe
hexEncode : String -> String
```

Hex-encode a string (lowercase output, two hex digits per byte).

## `hexDecode`

```ipe
hexDecode : String -> Result Error String
```

Hex-decode a string.

Returns `Err` when the input has an odd length or contains a character
outside `[0-9a-fA-F]`.
